name: commander notes
summary: The commander has a pseudo record prefix CN. A CN is only ever written inline in a document, as a thought or point the commander wants to keep. It can be searched on demand and is not extracted or acted on.
statement: Commander has a pseudo record prefix 'CN:'. This pseudo record is only ever recorded inline in a document as a thought or point the commander wants to keep. They can be searched on demand but not intended for use.
context: Written by the commander under a Commander Response heading inside XD-008 (records/pilot/decisions/XD-008.md), beside the first CN he wrote, a note against the unit he struck there. A second CN sits inside XD-010.
